# WooCommerce Canva Connector Documentation

> Official documentation for Webkul's WooCommerce Canva Connector plugin, which lets store admins design, edit and publish WooCommerce product images with Canva without ever leaving the WordPress admin.

**When to use this documentation.** Use this site when you need to:

- Install or update the WooCommerce Canva Connector plugin on a WordPress site (system requirements, upload, activation).
- Configure the connector: Canva Developer Portal app, Canva Connect settings, redirect URIs and HTTPS, and building the Canva app bundle.
- Answer how-to questions about the design workflow: opening a product in Canva, using the Canva app sidebar, searching products by name or SKU, and saving designs back to the store.
- Understand the OAuth authorization flow between WordPress/WooCommerce and Canva.
- Troubleshoot the Canva connection on an existing WooCommerce store using this specific Webkul plugin.

Do not use this site for WooCommerce core documentation, other Canva integrations, or Webkul's Magento/Shopify products.

**How to consume this site.** Every documentation page is available as raw markdown: append `.md` to the page URL (e.g. `https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-canva-connector/documentation/installation.md`), or request any HTML URL with `Accept: text/markdown`. The full corpus in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-canva-connector/llms-full.txt). Machine-readable page list: [sitemap.xml](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-canva-connector/sitemap.xml).
